name: io.github.adityaarsharma/pickle
description: Free, local, open-source MCP server that audits your ClickUp, Slack & Microsoft Teams for work that slipped through — stale tasks, expired promises, decisions lost in a DM. Runs on your own machine with your own token; no account, no telemetry.
title: Pickle

environmentVariables.name: CLICKUP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own ClickUp personal API token (starts with pk_). Optional — set it to enable the 9 ClickUp audit patterns.

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your own Slack user OAuth token (starts with xoxp-). Optional — set it to enable the cross-tool Slack patterns.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your own Microsoft Graph access token. Optional — set it to enable the Microsoft Teams patterns.
